newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa proposes Wiking as new chair.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa proposes Wiking as new chair.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa said on Friday owners representing 55.7 percent of capital would propose Gosta Wiking as new chairman, replacing Peter Sjostrand who will become an ordinary board member.
Wiking, former chief executive of chemicals group Perstorp, will be a newcomer to Trygg-Hansa's board.
Tuve Johanesson, the head of Swedish vehicle maker Volvo's car division, would also be proposed as a new board member, the company said.
Trygg-Hansa will hold its annual general shareholders' meeting in Stockholm on May 6.
